summary: BlueLinx Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results. Stockholders voted on director elections, ratification of Ernst & Young as auditor, advisory say-on-pay, and an amendment to the 2021 Long-Term Incentive Plan to increase reserved shares. All proposals passed except director Mitchell B. Lewis was not elected. This is a routine governance filing; no special-situation event is present.
